_comment: One entry per photograph. Boxes are [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the image,
so they stay correct whatever resolution the photo was taken at.
'lines' is every line of text visible on the kiosk screen, transcribed by hand, in reading
order. 'controls' are the actionable buttons only. 'queries' are what a user would say and
which control they should reach. Omit 'queries' to skip target evaluation for an image.
Do NOT include PINs, card numbers, balances, names or any other personal data.
